title: Squadron safety survey turns up four more unreported near-midairs

tellings.quote: And as it turned out, there were like four other near midairs that our squadron had over the past, you know, few months with this issue that went unreported.

plain: After a near collision with an unknown object, a Navy fighter pilot named Ryan Graves says his squadron near Virginia Beach filed a hazard report, the military's formal safety report, and a follow-up survey found "like four other near midairs" with the same issue over the past few months that had never been reported. Graves tells Michels this as someone who was in the squadron at the time. He tells it to show that pilots were having close calls with these objects and keeping quiet about them.
